sources: Joyal & Carpentier (2017). The prevalence of paraphilic interests and behaviors in the general population. Journal of Sex Research 54(2). 1,040 adults (Quebec); 45.6% desire for at least one paraphilic behavior, 33.9% experience; fetishism desire women 47.9% vs men 40.4% (n.s.); masochism desire women 27.8% vs men 19.2%; men higher in voyeurism/frotteurism; sample not fully probabilistic.
